_about: Generic handover manifest. Runs against the deck demo: python ../engine/example_deck.py, then BEHANCE=1 python ../engine/example_deck.py, then python ../engine/handover.py build handover_manifest.json --dry-run. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_build_marker: Run `handover.py mark` at the START of each render run; any non-static source older than the marker was not re-rendered and fails the build.

client.intro: Everything for review and everyday use. The PDF is the full presentation; the card images are ready for slides and screens.

cover._sizes: omit to use the platform's own: behance 1616x1264 + 808x632

notes: Concept PDF only: the printer's PDF/X-4 export, with their profile and the converter's dieline, replaces it.

handover.colour: Screen files are sRGB. Print colour is set in the press PDF and governed by the printer's profile and a signed proof.

fonts.name: Anton
fonts.holder: the type designer (free, commercial use allowed)

handover._ai: Add an 'ai' block (line, tools) and mark items "ai": true when an AI background plate is used; the README then carries the disclosure.
handover.support: 30 days of small fixes from the delivery date.
handover.status_note: These are concept files. Nothing here goes to press until the printer has proofed it.
